response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratios, AVG(line_count) AS avg_line_item_count FROM (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(CASE WHEN ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_total_cost <> 0 AND ili.product_price IS NOT NULL THEN ili.product_price * 1.0 / ili.derived_total_cost END) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_count FROM Order_Items oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) t
